snippet.title: Rules of Engagement: The Grey State - Official Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Rules of Engagement: The Grey State is a Tactical RPG Shooter set in a unique Horrorverse. Craft your own build, survive nightmarish creatures and rival squads, and get paid. This isn't about saving the world. It's just business.
Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3978820/
Join our Discord: https://discord.gg/rulesofengagement/

Follow us:
Official site: https://rulesofengagement.com/
Official X: https://x.com/Play_ROE/
